Per the QA process ('a permanent ban or permanent zoning rule adopted instead of a pause is not a new moratorium row'), this looks like a strong REMOVE candidate, but I am marking it unresolvable rather than an outright REMOVE because the industry tracker (carina.energy) independently and specifically lists Ripley as an EXPIRED (not merely absent) BESS moratorium, which suggests the tracker may be drawing on a source I did not find (e.g., a separate un-indexed local law) rather than simply mis-describing the 2022 zoning law. Flagging for the coordinator to weigh the REMOVE case: current evidence favors it, but I could not affirmatively rule out a real, separately-adopted moratorium within budget.
